```{r, echo = F, message = F}
### Packages
#setwd("C/Users/kloria/Documents/Davis_data_exploration/")

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(dataRetrieval)
library(viridis)
library(cowplot)
library(zoo)
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(plotly)
library(readxl)
library(ggpmisc)


site_colors <- c(
  "Ophir" = "#7d5ba6",
  "Winters" = "#8b9933",
  "Winters upstream" = "#b6cf15",
  "Davis" = "#e2d346",
  "Browns" = "#117733", 
  "Browns sub"  = "#10de54"
)


site_lab_colors <- c(
  "ophir" = "#7d5ba6",
    "ophir_hw" = "#7d1ba6",
  "winters_usgs" = "#8b9933",
  "winters_up" = "#b6cf15",
  "davis" = "#e2d346",
  "browns" = "#117733", 
  "browns_sub"  = "#10de54",
   "browns_hw"  = "#bd272d"
)


# Creek labels and facet order
creek_levels <- c(
  "Browns Creek",
  "Winters Creek",
  "Davis Creek",
  "Ophir Creek"
)

site_labels <- c(
  "browns"       = "Browns",
  "browns_sub"   = "Browns sub.",
  "winters_usgs" = "Winters USGS",
  "winters_up"   = "Winters up",
  "davis"        = "Davis",
  "ophir"        = "Ophir"
)

```


```{r, eval=TRUE, echo = F, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
##### Function for water year:
# fxn for water year
water_year <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>%
    mutate(WaterYear = if_else(month(date) >= 10, year(date) + 1, year(date)))
}
```

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Chem data


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

UVvis_data <- read.csv(
  uvvis_file <- "/Users/kellyloria/Documents/DRI/UVvis_Reno/uvvis_corrected_20261020/processed_optical_metrics.csv") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(sample_date, format = "%m/%d/%y"))

water_chem <- read.csv("/Users/kellyloria/Documents/DRI/ERDC_Davis_Fire/Processes_data/QAQC_chemistry_TSS/ERDC_water_chem_QAQC_TSS_20261026_small_v2.csv") %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%y")) 
  
UVvis_data <- UVvis_data %>%
  distinct()


merged_df1 <- water_chem %>%
  left_join(UVvis_data, by = c("date", "site_lab" = "site")) %>%
  mutate(
  burn_lab = case_when(
      site_lab %in% c(
        "browns",
        "browns_sub",
        "winters_usgs",
        "winters_up",
        "davis"
      ) ~ "burned",

      site_lab %in% c(
        "ophir"
      ) ~ "unburned",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))


```

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

merged_calcs <- merged_df1%>%
  mutate(
    Sr = ss_275_295/ss_350_400,
    SUVA_254 = a_254/DOC_QC,
    SCDOM = cdom/DOC_QC)

## pause odd duplicates
merged_calcs <- merged_calcs %>%
  distinct()


library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

merged_calcs <- merged_calcs %>%
  group_by(site, datetime) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ reduce(.x, coalesce)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

### WRITE

  dplyr::select(site_lab, burn_lab, date,DOC_QC,BC_QC, a_254, e2_e3, cdom, ss_275_295, ss_350_400, slope_ratio, Sr, SUVA_254, SCDOM)%>%
  na.omit(small_df)

```





```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=3}

library(ggplot2)

p1 <- small_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BC_QC,
             y = SUVA_254)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = site_lab, shape = burn_lab),
    alpha = 0.8,
    size = 2,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  #labs(
   # y = expression("Algal biomass (g cm"^{-2}*")"),
   # x = NULL
  #) +
   
  # Site colors + clean legend labels
  scale_color_manual(
    values = site_lab_colors,
    labels = function(x) str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  ) +
  
  # Clean burn-status labels
  scale_shape_discrete(
    labels = function(x) str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  ) +
  
  # labs(
  #   y = expression("Algal biomass (g cm"^{-2}*")"),
  #   x = NULL,
  #   color = "Site",
  #   shape = "Burn status"
  # ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  ) + theme_minimal()
  
p1
```

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
p1 <- merged_calcs %>%
  filter(!is.na(cdom)) %>%
  mutate(
    creek = case_when(
      site_lab %in% c("browns", "browns_sub") ~ "Browns Creek",
      site_lab %in% c("winters_usgs", "winters_up") ~ "Winters Creek",
      site_lab == "davis" ~ "Davis Creek",
      site_lab == "ophir" ~ "Ophir Creek",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    creek = factor(creek, levels = creek_levels),
    site_lab = factor(site_lab, levels = names(site_labels))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(creek)) %>%
  arrange(site_lab, date) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = cdom,
      color = site_lab,
      group = site_lab,
      shape = burn_lab
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = site_lab_colors,
    breaks = names(site_labels),
    labels = site_labels,
    name = "Site"
  ) +

  scale_shape_discrete(
    labels = function(x) str_replace_all(x, "_", " "),
    name = "Burn status"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ creek,
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_y",
    drop = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_x_date(
    limits = c(
      as.Date("2024-10-01"),
      as.Date("2026-05-15")
    ),
    date_breaks = "2 months",
    date_labels = "%b-%y"
  ) +

  labs(
    y = expression("CDOM"),
    x = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 11,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

p1
  
  
```

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}


davis_dat <- davis_data %>%
  group_by(site_lab, date) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_bm_gcm2 = mean(AFDM.g.cm..2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bm = sd(AFDM.g.cm..2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```


### Mean and standard deviation of agal biomass on rocks each reach per visit. 

August to October 2025

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=3}

# Plot means ± SD
p2 <- davis_dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean_bm_gcm2, color = site_lab, group = site_lab)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_bm_gcm2 - sd_bm, ymax = mean_bm_gcm2 + sd_bm),
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = site_lab_colors) +
  labs(
    y ="Algal biomass (g cm^-2)",
    x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

p2

```
